summary: 1 blocking finding classified for repair: define readJson storage root alongside writeJson/writeText for spec-local plugin artifacts.

items.title: Spec-local artifact read path is omitted
items.rationale: The finding is blocking because the public artifact helper exposes readJson, writeJson, and writeText as one contract. Moving only writes to specs/<spec>/plugin-artifacts would leave read-modify-write hooks split across roots.
items.evidence: spec.json R4 and AC7 currently mention write behavior only. src/lib/plugin-registry.js artifactHelpers exposes readJson, writeJson, and writeText; spec #286 tests use readJson for hook artifact read-modify-write flows.
